title: FFPE Tissue Sectioning for Staining
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8kvhuw6
materials: Section the tissue between 4-5 µm thick.

steps.title: Prepare water bath
steps.instruction: Set a water bath to 42 °C and position it next to the microtome.

steps.title: Insert fresh microtome blade
steps.instruction: Insert a new blade into the microtome for each tissue block.

steps.title: Float sections in water
steps.instruction: Place the freshly cut tissue sections into the 42 °C water bath for a few seconds, watching them expand.

steps.title: Transfer sections to charged slide
steps.instruction: When the sections have expanded enough to eliminate folds and wrinkles, quickly submerge a positively charged microscope slide in the water bath and gently lift it upward toward the tissue so the section adheres to the slide.

steps.title: Remove slide with tissue
steps.instruction: Continue moving the slide out of the water bath; the tissue will lay flat on the slide as it is withdrawn.

steps.title: Dry slides
steps.instruction: Place the slides upright in a rack and either let them air‑dry overnight or dry them in a 50 °C oven for 1 hour.

steps.title: Label slides
steps.instruction: Label the positively charged microscope slides appropriately.
